verses.original: Ἀδελφοί καὶ ἐὰν ἄνθρωπος προλημφθῇ ἔν τινι παραπτώματι ὑμεῖς οἱ πνευματικοὶ καταρτίζετε τὸν τοιοῦτον ἐν πνεύματι πραΰτητος σκοπῶν σεαυτόν μὴ σὺ καὶ πειρασθῇς
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi kai ean anthrōpos prolēmphthē en tini paraptōmati hymeis hoi pneumatikoi katartizete ton toiouton en pneumati prautētos skopōn seauton mē sy kai peirasthēs
verses.literal: Brothers - if someone is caught in a trespass you who are spiritual should restore - him with a spirit of gentleness [But] watch yourself or you also may be tempted

verses.original: βαστάζετε Ἀλλήλων τὰ βάρη καὶ οὕτως ἀναπληρώσετε τὸν νόμον τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: bastazete Allēlōn ta barē kai houtōs anaplērōsete ton nomon tou Christou
verses.literal: Carry one another’s - burdens and in this way you will fulfill the law - of Christ

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ τις δοκεῖ εἶναί τι ὤν μηδὲν φρεναπατᾷ ἑαυτόν
verses.transliteration: gar ei tis dokei einai ti ōn mēden phrenapata heauton
verses.literal: - If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing he deceives himself

verses.original: δὲ ἕκαστος δοκιμαζέτω ἑαυτοῦ Τὸ ἔργον καὶ τότε ἕξει τὸ καύχημα εἰς ἑαυτὸν μόνον καὶ οὐκ εἰς τὸν ἕτερον
verses.transliteration: de hekastos dokimazetō heautou To ergon kai tote hexei to kauchēma eis heauton monon kai ouk eis ton heteron
verses.literal: - Each one should test his own - work - Then he will have - reason to boast in himself alone and not in - someone else

verses.original: γὰρ ἕκαστος βαστάσει τὸ ἴδιον φορτίον
verses.transliteration: gar hekastos bastasei to idion phortion
verses.literal: For each one should carry - his own load

verses.original: δὲ ὁ κατηχούμενος τὸν λόγον Κοινωνείτω ἐν πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς τῷ κατηχοῦντι
verses.transliteration: de ho katēchoumenos ton logon Koinōneitō en pasin agathois tō katēchounti
verses.literal: Nevertheless the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with [his] instructor

verses.original: Μὴ πλανᾶσθε Θεὸς οὐ μυκτηρίζεται γὰρ ὃ ἐὰν ἄνθρωπος σπείρῃ τοῦτο καὶ θερίσει
verses.transliteration: Mē planasthe Theos ou myktērizetai gar ho ean anthrōpos speirē touto kai therisei
verses.literal: {Do} not be deceived God {is} not to be mocked - Whatever . . . a man sows vvv vvv he will reap in return

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ σπείρων εἰς ἑαυτοῦ τὴν σάρκα ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς θερίσει φθοράν δὲ ὁ σπείρων εἰς τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος θερίσει αἰώνιον ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: hoti ho speirōn eis heautou tēn sarka ek tēs sarkos therisei phthoran de ho speirōn eis to Pneuma ek tou Pneumatos therisei aiōnion zōēn
verses.literal: - The [one] who sows to please his - flesh from the flesh will reap destruction but the [one] who sows to please the Spirit from the Spirit will reap eternal life

verses.original: δὲ μὴ ἐνκακῶμεν Τὸ καλὸν ποιοῦντες γὰρ ἰδίῳ καιρῷ θερίσομεν μὴ ἐκλυόμενοι
verses.transliteration: de mē enkakōmen To kalon poiountes gar idiō kairō therisomen mē eklyomenoi
verses.literal: - vvv Let us not grow weary - [in] well-doing . . . for in due time we will reap a harvest vvv if we do not give up

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς ἔχομεν καιρὸν ἐργαζώμεθα τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς πάντας δὲ μάλιστα πρὸς τοὺς οἰκείους τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Ara oun hōs echomen kairon ergazōmetha to agathon pros pantas de malista pros tous oikeious tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: vvv Therefore as we have opportunity let us do - good to everyone and especially to the family of faith

verses.original: Ἴδετε πηλίκοις γράμμασιν ἔγραψα ὑμῖν τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί
verses.transliteration: Idete pēlikois grammasin egrapsa hymin tē emē cheiri
verses.literal: See [what] large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand

verses.original: Ὅσοι θέλουσιν εὐπροσωπῆσαι ἐν σαρκί οὗτοι ἀναγκάζουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι μόνον ἵνα μὴ διώκωνται τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hosoi thelousin euprosōpēsai en sarki houtoi anankazousin hymas peritemnesthai monon hina mē diōkōntai tō staurō tou Christou
verses.literal: Those who want to make a good impression vvv outwardly - are trying to compel you to be circumcised [They] only [ do this ] to avoid persecution for the cross - of Christ

verses.original: γὰρ οἱ περιτεμνόμενοι οὐδὲ φυλάσσουσιν νόμον αὐτοὶ ἀλλὰ θέλουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι ἵνα καυχήσωνται ἐν ὑμετέρᾳ τῇ σαρκὶ
verses.transliteration: gar hoi peritemnomenoi oude phylassousin nomon autoi alla thelousin hymas peritemnesthai hina kauchēsōntai en hymetera tē sarki
verses.literal: For the circumcised {do} not even keep [the] law themselves yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your - flesh

verses.original: δὲ Ἐμοὶ γένοιτο μὴ καυχᾶσθαι εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ σταυρῷ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δι’ οὗ κόσμος ἐσταύρωται ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: de Emoi genoito mē kauchasthai ei mē en tō staurō hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou di’ hou kosmos estaurōtai emoi kagō kosmō
verses.literal: But as for me may {I} never boast except . . . in the cross of our - Lord Jesus Christ through which [the] world has been crucified to me and I [to the] world

verses.original: γὰρ οὔτε περιτομή οὔτε ἀκροβυστία ἐστιν τί ἀλλὰ καινὴ κτίσις
verses.transliteration: gar oute peritomē oute akrobystia estin ti alla kainē ktisis
verses.literal: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything [What counts is] a new creation

verses.original: Καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ ἔλεος ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ὅσοι τῷ στοιχήσουσιν τούτῳ κανόνι καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai eirēnē kai eleos ep’ autous hosoi tō stoichēsousin toutō kanoni kai epi ton Israēl tou Theou
verses.literal: - Peace and mercy to - all who walk by this rule even to the Israel - of God

verses.original: Τοῦ λοιποῦ μηδεὶς παρεχέτω μοι κόπους γὰρ ἐγὼ βαστάζω ἐν μου τῷ σώματί τὰ στίγματα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tou loipou mēdeis parechetō moi kopous gar egō bastazō en mou tō sōmati ta stigmata tou Iēsou
verses.literal: - From now on {let} no one cause me trouble for I bear on my - body the marks - of Jesus

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ ὑμῶν τοῦ πνεύματος ἀδελφοί Ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou meta hymōn tou pneumatos adelphoi Amēn
verses.literal: The grace of our - Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your - spirit brothers Amen
